text: The paper restates prior results: with only a pure optimization oracle, a lower bound from [21] shows that Omega(sqrt N) external regret is unavoidable without additional structure, whereas with a smooth optimization oracle the Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader algorithm of [24] has regret scaling logarithmically in N. The paper records the latter as Corollary 3.
title: External regret: Omega(sqrt N) with a pure oracle vs log N with a smooth oracle (FTPL)
